name: @crossly/buyer-cli
description: Your Crossly shopping from the terminal — cart, orders, wishlists, offers and cashback.

scripts._typecheck_note: buyer-mcp's and buyer-sdk's dist/ are gitignored and their exports maps type there, so `tsc --noEmit` alone fails on a fresh clone (TS2307 on @crossly/buyer-mcp/registry) or checks against a stale registry (the round-6 vault tools missing). `pnpm -r build` gets away with it because it is topologically ordered AND emits; `pnpm -r typecheck` is ordered but emits nothing, so both dependencies are built here, SDK first (pnpm runs a filtered set in dependency order). Tests need no build: vitest.config.ts reads both packages from source.
